title: Spec Registry Service
description: Connection to spec-registryd (TASK-12 auth path). Both values come from the install block shown once when the IdP is bound — or from your own self-hosted deployment.

serviceUrl.title: Service URL
serviceUrl.description: Base URL of spec-registryd (its /mcp and REST endpoints). Take it from the install block shown once at IdP bind, or the URL of your own deployment — there is no default.

serviceBridgeToken.title: Service bridge token
serviceBridgeToken.description: App-to-service secret from the install block (shown once, stored hashed). Identifies which IdP binding this app speaks for — it is not a user credential.
